channel.title: EOL Watch
channel.description: Security advisories landing on end-of-life branches with no fix shipped for the dead line. Candidates, not confirmed exposures.

item.title: CRITICAL: Drupal 10.3, 11.0, 10.2, 10.1, 10.0
item.description: Drupal Core has a SQL Injection issue Affected range >= 8.9.0, < 10.4.10, fixed in 10.4.10, nothing shipped for 10.3, 11.0, 10.2, 10.1, 10.0.
